title: FM open to views on LTCG and STT

timeline.title: FM open to views on LTCG and STT
timeline.line: Sitharaman's Tuesday remarks sparked a 1,109-pt Sensex rally, but no change is promised
more: She said the STT debate is healthy and some argue only one of the two taxes should stay
She declined to commit, citing the early stage of Budget preparation
SBI Research has called for scrapping LTCG, with FPI outflows at ₹3.08 lakh cr in 2026

src.title: Business Today: LTCG, STT debate — FM to 'tread cautiously'
